fix.author: jddunn
fix.description: take the content types and the kind pattern from the schema files
fix.body:
npm run validate refused a thread whose contentType is lesson, exercise or assessment, which the thread
schema takes, and passed a weave or a loom whose kind the schemas refuse. The validator now reads the
contentType list from thread.schema.yaml and the kind pattern from weave.schema.yaml and loom.schema.yaml.

fix.author: jddunn
fix.description: a catalogue entry lists each subject once, and the record says which rules a reader checks
fix.body:
An entry's subjects take uniqueItems, so a schema reader refuses a subject listed twice. Four rules cannot be
held by a JSON Schema: an id or a slug listed once, a link that names something the record lists, a home that is
one of the entry's subjects, and no circle. The record's description now says a reader checks them.

feat.author: jddunn
feat.description: a kind on the weave and the loom, and the catalogue record
feat.body:
A course is a weave of kind course and a unit is a loom of kind unit. catalogue.schema.yaml describes
catalogue.yaml at a fabric's root: the subjects its weaves sit under, each weave's home subject and
which weave builds on which. Both are additions: a weave or a loom without kind reads as before.

ci.author: Johnny Dunn
ci.description: skip onnxruntime-node's CUDA download, whose 1.21.0 asset answers 404
ci.body:
onnxruntime-node's postinstall fetches onnxruntime-linux-x64-gpu-1.21.0.tgz
on linux x64, and that asset now returns 404, so every install in these
jobs failed. The CPU runtime ships inside the package.

fix.author: Johnny Dunn
fix.body:
createDatabase reads the SQLite path from `file`. The cache passed it as
betterSqlite3.filename, which the storage adapter never reads, so the
cache opened at the adapter's default path while its log named
.cache/codex.db.
